'''Alba Marina Cotes Prado''' (Bogota, February 15 1959), is a [[Colombians|Colombian]] [[chemist]] and [[biologist]], known for her research on [[biological pest control]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=CvLAC - RG - Minciencias - Alba Marina Cotes Prado|url=http://scienti.colciencias.gov.co:8081/cvlac/visualizador/generarCurriculoCv.do?cod_rh=0000215350|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=|website=}}{{Dead link|date=August 2023 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> In 2009, Cotes became the first [[Latin Americans|Latin American]] woman in receive a [[Honoris causa|Honoris Causa]] degree from the [[Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|last=Tiempo|first=Casa Editorial El|title='Mi pasión, los microorganismos', declara investigadora colombiana, Ph.D. Alba Marina Cotes|url=https://www.portafolio.co/economia/finanzas/mi-pasion-microorganismos-declara-investigadora-colombiana-ph-d-alba-marina-cotes-395378|access-date=2020-10-30|website=Portafolio.co|language=spanish}}</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite web|last=Dinero|title=Mentes brillantes|url=http://www.dinero.com/edicion-impresa/negocios/articulo/cientificas-colombianas/194691|access-date=2020-10-30|website=Científicas colombianas|language=spanish|archive-date=2020-10-21|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201021221323/https://www.dinero.com/edicion-impresa/negocios/articulo/cientificas-colombianas/194691|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref name=":3">{{Cite web|title=Mentes brillantes al servicio de la ciencia y la innovación {{!}} CONtexto ganadero {{!}} Noticias principales sobre ganadería y agricultura en Colombia|url=https://www.contextoganadero.com/cronica/mentes-brillantes-al-servicio-de-la-ciencia-y-la-innovacion|access-date=2020-10-30|website=www.contextoganadero.com|language=es}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Cotes finished a [[bachelor's degree]] in [[chemistry]] and [[biology]] at [[Free University of Colombia]] in 1980.<ref>{{cite book |title=Universidad Libre. Libro de Oro|editor-last=Baena Upegui|editor-first=Mario|publisher=Escala|location=Bogotá|page=243|language=es|year=1995|isbn=978-958-33-0250-3}}</ref> Then, she started her [[Graduate school|graduate]] studies at [[University of Los Andes (Colombia)|Universidad of los Andes]] in 1982. She did graduate programs in [[food microbiology]] and [[industrial microbiology]], followed by a [[master's degree]] in [[microbiology]] (1986). Cotes did also a master's degree in [[agricultural biotechnology]] in 1988 and a [[Doctor of Philosophy|Ph.D]] in [[Agricultural science|agricultural sciences]] focused on [[phytopathology]] in 1994, both at [[Gembloux Agro-Bio Tech]] in Belgium. In 2009, she received a [[Honoris causa|Honoris Causa]] degree by the [[Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences]].<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":2" /><ref name=":3" /><ref>{{Cite web|last=Tiempo|first=Casa Editorial El|date=2009-10-20|title=PROTAGONISTA|url=https://www.eltiempo.com/archivo/documento/MAM-3677297|access-date=2020-10-30|website=El Tiempo|language=spanish}}</ref>

In 1994, Cotes started working at the [[Colombian Corporation for Agricultural Research]] (CORPOICA) as the Biotechnology Center director, where she started a research group focused on the development of [[Pesticide|pesticides]] for [[Phytopathogen|phytopathogen control]] in [[agriculture]]. In addition, she has been professor in multiple academic institutions in Colombia, such as [[University of Los Andes (Colombia)|Universidad of los Andes]], [[Nueva Granada Military University]], and [[Pedagogical and Technological University of Colombia]]. She has published more than one hundred papers in peer review journals, twenty books, and twelve book chapters.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":4">{{Cite web|title=Cotes Prado, Alba Marina-|url=https://agriperfiles.agri-d.net/display/n395898|access-date=2020-10-30|website=agriperfiles.agri-d.net|language=en}}</ref>

== Selected publications ==
The following is Cotes most notable publications.<ref name=":0" />

* 2006 - ''Resumen de Investigaciones en el Control Biológico de las Moscas Blancas'' (Research Summary  on the Biological Control of Whiteflies) {{ISBN|958-8210-88-7}}
* 2005 - ''Reconocimiento, Selección y Evaluación de Aislamientos Nativos de Virus de la Granulosis para el Control Biológico de la Polilla Guatemalteca de la Papa'' (Recognition, Selection and Evaluation of Native Isolates of Granulosis Virus for the Biological Control of the Guatemalan Potato Moth) {{ISBN|958-8210-87-9}}
* 2012 - ''Uso de Lecanicillium Lecanii para el Control de la Mosca Blanca (''Lecanicillium Lecanii Use for Whitefly Control) {{ISBN|978-958-740-106-6}}
* 2012 - ''Uso de los Compuestos Volátiles de la Papa en el Control de la Polilla Guatemalteca'' (Use of the Volatile Compounds of the Potato in the Control of the Guatemalan Moth) {{ISBN|978-958-740-096-0}}
* 2009 - ''Levaduras nativas como aditivos funcionales para mejorar la nutrición de monogástricos y rumiantes en condiciones tropicales'' (Native yeasts as functional additives to improve monogastric and ruminant nutrition in tropical conditions) {{ISBN|978-958-740-001-4}}
* {{cite book |last1=Cotes |first1=Alba Marina |title=Control biológico de fitopatógenos, insectos y ácaros |trans-title=Biological control of phytopathogenics, insects and mites|date=October 2018 |publisher=Mosquera-Bogotá : Agrosavia Editorial |location=Mosquera, Colombia |isbn=9789587402551 |language=Spanish|oclc=1224242156}}

== Awards and honours ==
Cotes has been awarded the following honours.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":4" /><ref name=":5" />
*Successful Women Award -   Science and Technology category, Fundación Mujeres de Éxito, 2013<ref name=":5">{{Cite web|title=Alba Marina Cotes Prado|url=https://fundacionmujeresdeexito.org/profile/alba-marina-cotes-prado/|access-date=2020-10-30|website=Fundación Mujeres de Exito|language=es}}</ref>
* National Award in Phytopathology - Colombian Association of Phytopathology and Related Sciences, 2011
* Recognition for outstanding scientific work - Corporación para el Desarrollo Industrial De La Biotecnología, 2008
* Scientific Merit Medal - Colombian Agricultural Research Corporation, 2009
* Luis Hernando Pino Santiago National Entomology Prize - [[Colombian Society of Entomology]], 2009
* Honorary Doctorate in Agricultural Sciences -  [[Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences]], 2009
* Honorable Mention - Colombian Society of Entomology, 2000
* National Prize for Soil Science - [[Colombian Society of Soil Science]], 2000
* National Phytopathology Award - Colombian Association of Phytopathology and Related Sciences, 1998
* Professor Ad-honorem - Institute of Biotechnology, [[National University of Colombia]], 1994
